description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the HelpService component in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing help-related features like URL retrieval and validation.

classes.name: HelpServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the HelpService, testing functionalities such as URL retrieval, validation, and helper service integrations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating HelpService and setting up test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetHelpConfigService
methods.description: Tests that HelpService returns an instance of HelpConfigService.

methods.name: testGetZendeskHelpProcessor
methods.description: Verifies that HelpService provides an instance of ZendeskHelpProcessor.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the correct help article URL when the article exists.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl2
methods.description: Tests fallback behavior to default URL when the help article is not found.

methods.name: testGetDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Checks that the default redirect URL is correctly returned.

methods.name: testIsValidUrl
methods.description: Validates that the current help URL from configuration is considered valid.

methods.name: testIsValidUrl2
methods.description: Tests URL validation logic with an invalid base help URL.
